blocks.label: First touch
blocks.body:
Subject: {{company}}'s site vs. the three ranking above it

Hi {{firstName}},

I pulled up {{company}} while looking at {{industry}} companies in {{city}}. Three competitors are outranking you on the searches your buyers actually use, and two of them have weaker offers than you do.

That gap is usually a site-structure problem, not a budget problem.

I put together a short breakdown of what they're doing differently. Want me to send it over?

Danish
FrontPage Labs
frontpagelabs.com

blocks.label: Follow-up (day 4)
blocks.body:
Subject: Re: {{company}}'s site vs. the three ranking above it

Hi {{firstName}},

Floating this back up in case it got buried.

The short version: {{company}} is invisible on the searches that matter most, and the fix is mostly structural. Happy to walk you through it in ten minutes, no pitch.

Worth a look?

Danish

blocks.label: Breakup (day 12)
blocks.body:
Subject: Closing the loop

Hi {{firstName}},

I'll stop here so I'm not cluttering your inbox.

If growing {{company}} online moves up the list later this year, the breakdown I mentioned is yours whenever you want it. Just reply and I'll send it.

Either way, good luck this quarter.

Danish

blocks.label: Connection note
blocks.body: Hi {{firstName}} — I work with {{industry}} companies in {{city}} on websites and paid acquisition. Been following what {{company}} is building. Would like to connect.

blocks.label: First message
blocks.body:
Thanks for connecting, {{firstName}}.

Quick reason I reached out: I looked at how {{company}} shows up for the searches your buyers run, and there's a clear gap between your offer and how the site presents it.

I can send a two-minute breakdown of what I'd change. Want it?

blocks.label: Cold DM
blocks.body: Hey {{firstName}} — your work at {{company}} looks great, but the site isn't doing it justice. We build sites and ad systems for {{industry}} brands. Want me to send a quick teardown of what I'd change?

blocks.label: Story-reply follow-up
blocks.body:
Appreciate the reply! Here's what I'd look at first for {{company}}:

1. The homepage doesn't say what you do in the first screen
2. No clear next step for someone ready to buy
3. Nothing capturing the people who aren't ready yet

Happy to go deeper on a quick call if useful.

blocks.label: Cold call opener
blocks.body:
Hi, is this {{firstName}}?

This is Danish with FrontPage Labs here in Chicago. I'll be quick — this is a cold call, you can tell me to go away.

(pause)

We build websites and run ads for {{industry}} companies. I was looking at {{company}} and noticed you're getting outranked by a few competitors on the searches your customers actually use.

Is growing online something you're actively working on right now, or is it on the back burner?

blocks.label: Discovery questions
blocks.body:
1. How are people finding you today?
2. What's working best right now, and what's disappointing you?
3. If we doubled your inbound next quarter, could you handle it?
4. Who else weighs in on a decision like this?
5. What would have to be true for this to be an easy yes?

blocks.label: Objection — "too expensive"
blocks.body:
That's fair, and I'd rather you not spend it than spend it in the wrong place.

Can I ask — is it expensive against your budget, or expensive against what you expect to get back? Those are different problems and the second one is mine to solve.

If one new {{industry}} client is worth {{clientValue}} to you, the math usually works out well before the year is up. Want me to run those numbers on a call?
